appearance_facts.fact: Chart title is 'Units Sold by Product (Weekend Pop-up)'
Y-axis is labeled 'Units Sold' and has tick marks at 2,000, 4,000, 6,000, 8,000, and 10,000
X-axis is labeled 'Product' and lists products: Product E, Product A, Product C, Product D, Product B
Bar for Product A is the shortest, reaching approximately 1,800 units on the y-axis
Bar for Product E reaches 8,000 units
Bar for Product D reaches 10,000 units
Bar for Product C reaches 2,200 units
Bar for Product B reaches 6,000 units

public_definitions: Review the weekend pop-up Units Sold by Product dashboard, then complete the Product A merchandising review intake by selecting the appropriate product route.
